threads.heading: Topics
threads.description: News in the topics you follow:

noOrg.subject: Create your team’s org chart
noOrg.title: Your Rolebase account is ready
noOrg.paragraph1: Hi {{name}}, all that’s left is to create your organization.
noOrg.paragraph2: Give it a name, then add your main roles and the people who hold them. You watch the org chart come together as you go.
noOrg.paragraph3: Then invite your team so everyone can see who does what.

noSetup.subject: Finish the {{org}} org chart
noSetup.title: {{org}} is almost ready
noSetup.paragraph1: Hi {{name}}, your organization {{org}} is created. All that’s left is to choose how it works and add the people who are part of it.
noSetup.paragraph2: It takes two minutes: the org chart comes together as you go, and you can change everything afterwards.

noInvite.subject: Need a hand with {{org}}?
noInvite.title: A hand with what comes next?
noInvite.paragraph1: Hi {{name}}, I’m Godefroy, founder of Rolebase. The {{org}} org chart is in place. If you have a question about what comes next (describing roles, running a first meeting, bringing your team in), just reply to this email and I’ll answer personally.
noInvite.paragraph2: When you’re ready, inviting someone only takes their email address, and the first 5 accounts are free.
noInvite.paragraph2Members_one: When you’re ready, the member you added can see the org chart: inviting them only takes their email address, and the first 5 accounts are free.
noInvite.paragraph2Members_other: When you’re ready, the {{count}} members you added can see the org chart: inviting them only takes their email addresses, and the first 5 accounts are free.
